invoice-matching:d6909485ada9aa8babfb765.text: R01 :: An invoice requires both an existing purchase order and a receipt record before automatic payment.

invoice-matching:7e7500243648f884e151cc9.text: R02 :: An invoice variance of exactly EUR 10 is within tolerance.

invoice-matching:2d48c9c418dadb7e274719c.text: R03 :: An invoice variance above EUR 10 blocks automatic payment.

invoice-matching:fd5ba794e0dc7bcf88e45b9.text: R04 :: For a blocked invoice, an Accounts Payable analyst may ask for a corrected invoice but is not obliged to ask.

invoice-matching:415fd8faef159cebbe577db.text: R05 :: Only the receiving team records goods receipt; Accounts Payable cannot record goods receipt.

invoice-matching:c25f8e0c11f46955d6d20b1.text: R06 :: The person who changed supplier bank details must not approve payment to those details.

invoice-matching:82b561f3ea5ba823bfa6fbc.text: R07 :: For a service invoice, an authorised service acceptance replaces the goods receipt record.

invoice-matching:e8d8dbd600a63f596a23652.text: R08 :: Service acceptance does not replace the purchase-order requirement.

invoice-matching:db74f6282efe450856cd756.text: R09 :: A dispute freezes the payment clock until the dispute is resolved.

invoice-matching:0364f60f447875d95e48568.text: R10 :: After dispute resolution, the payment clock resumes from its paused value rather than restarting at zero.

invoice-matching:56945622b4402bcbb265fec.text: R11 :: An invoice number is unique only within a supplier; different suppliers may reuse the same number.

invoice-matching:a09b21dbe9a0080fa72bed2.text: R12 :: The tolerance is assessed per invoice, not against the monthly sum of a supplier invoices.

purchase-approval:094d05cb889e4b8ef10250.text: "R01": "R01 A purchase above EUR 5,000 must receive Finance approval before the purchase order is issued."

purchase-approval:c449ecc41a677bb8b44f3d.text: R01 :: For a purchase amount above EUR 5,000, Finance approval must be received before the purchase order is issued.

purchase-approval:3d4385df886d403eb9c37c.text: R02 :: Finance approval is not required for a purchase of exactly EUR 5,000.

purchase-approval:9792bb68931adcb16e94b9.text: R03 :: For a purchase below EUR 5,000, the department manager may approve it but is not obliged to do so.

purchase-approval:90ddda6404013247118d97.text: R04 :: A requester must never approve their own purchase request.

purchase-approval:d0e11c1dfe29b94671cc43.text: R05 :: An emergency purchase is exempt from obtaining competitive quotations.

purchase-approval:1b71dd34e6d7a47a3190d5.text: R06 :: The emergency quotation exemption does not remove the Finance approval requirement above EUR 5,000.

purchase-approval:01919d3ff24e34b3802905.text: R07 :: Only the Head of Finance can provide the Finance approval; the buyer cannot provide it.

purchase-approval:b1ffa6fedeeec18fba0074.text: R08 :: If a requester cancels a request before approval, that requester must record the cancellation reason.

purchase-approval:fe6bb4610f3fa5a6cbdc69.text: R09 :: Approval records must be retained for at least 30 calendar days and cannot be deleted earlier.

purchase-approval:0ec9223f17b29a05ac282f.text: R10 :: The purchase threshold applies separately to each request, not to the monthly total for a supplier.

purchase-approval:2c31b8970ceb18710e629e.text: R11 :: Different suppliers may have the same supplier name; supplier name is not a unique identifier.

purchase-approval:65a097b3588972e179b0ed.text: R12 :: The retention period begins on the approval date, not the purchase-order date.
